# EV+ Auto Repair

> EV+ Auto Repair is a family-owned, independent Tesla and EV collision repair
> and service shop in Sun Valley, Los Angeles. Tesla service and maintenance is
> Tesla-only; collision and body repair covers Teslas, other EVs, and gas
> vehicles. Free inspections and estimates. 6-12 months labor warranty. Photo
> updates during every repair. Insurance claims handled start to finish.
> On-site Tesla rentals are available while your car is repaired (optional,
> based on availability).

- Address: 9755 Glenoaks Blvd, Sun Valley, CA 91352
- Phone: (818) 281-7757
- Email: info@evplusautorepair.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM-3:00 PM, Sun closed
- Website: https://evplusautorepair.com

## Services

- Tesla service and maintenance: inspections, diagnostics, drive-unit oil
  service, suspension and steering, 12V and 16V battery service, HV battery
  replacement, cabin filters and radiator cleaning, tire rotation.
- Tesla and EV collision repair: structural and panel repair, factory paint
  matching and refinishing, ADAS and camera calibration, insurance claims.
- Radiator and condenser cleaning: $150 (Tesla charges $330-$350).
- Drive-unit oil service: $280 per unit, $560 dual-motor.
- Control arm replacement: full control arms only. We do not replace bushings
  alone.
- 12V battery service: about $250 in-shop.
